title: Learning: The Split
text: The network breaks in two. A write arrives at the leader; on the other side, a follower asks for votes.
held: Only the side with a majority made promises.

cards.label: Replicate it and commit on a majority
Refuse the write: there is no majority
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

fields.label: followers you can reach
fields.check: Count the followers that answer you

intrusion.detail: Neither follower answers. You are alone.
intrusion.correct: Refuse the write: there is no majority
intrusion.why: Alone, the leader can't commit. Saying yes would be a promise the other side is about to overwrite.
intrusion.reveal: The Leader was cut off from both followers when the write arrived.

temptations.label: Accept the write locally and merge when the network heals
temptations.why: That is split brain: two sides each with their own history, and no rule for which one survives.

cards.label: Refuse the vote
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

fields.label: candidate's log
fields.value: as up to date as yours
fields.check: Compare the candidate's last entry with yours
fields.ok: Its last entry is as recent as yours.

intrusion.value: missing the last two committed entries
intrusion.detail: The candidate's log stops two entries short of yours.
intrusion.why: A leader missing committed entries would erase them. Only a candidate whose log is at least as current may win.
intrusion.reveal: The candidate asking for votes was missing two committed entries.

teaches: Without a majority a node must refuse, however inconvenient. Availability is what is given up to stay consistent.
Votes go only to candidates whose logs are at least as up to date, so committed entries survive every election.
